description: RAG manifest for Software Engineer / Task Planner. All collections are distilled into local knowledge files. Raw sources are never accessible at runtime.

collections.description: Foundational software engineering practices. Distilled into P1, P2, P7 (principles.md), H1, H7, H9 (heuristics.md), Card001, Card003 (knowledge_cards.md), DR011 (decision_rules.md).
key_concepts: Rubber duck debugging — articulate the task

collections.description: Software construction practices. Distilled into P2, P4 (principles.md), H2, H6, H8 (heuristics.md), Card003, Card006 (knowledge_cards.md).
Software design principles applicable to task planning. Supports decomposition and modularity decisions.

collections.display_name: Design Patterns — Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software (Gang of Four)
collections.description: Classic design patterns. Distilled into P5 (principles.md), H3 (heuristics.md), Card002 (knowledge_cards.md). Relevant when planning tasks that implement patterns.

Observer pattern — separate event handler tasks

collections.description: Integration and messaging patterns. Distilled into P3 (principles.md), H4 (heuristics.md), Card007 (knowledge_cards.md). Particularly relevant for API route and cron task planning.
key_concepts: Message channel — API route as integration point
Message transformation — Zod schema as canonical form
Dead letter channel — error handling tasks

collections.display_name: Reference Architecture — Task Planner View (internal normative document)

Server Components before Server Actions before SWR rule
audit_log and sync_log structured JSON rule
